long_biography.plain_text:
After earning an economics degree from Denison University, Anthony “Tony” Mayer entered the family’s Denver oil-and-gas world. He founded Savant Resources in 1988 and two years later established Captiva Resources with his father, Frederick Mayer, after the sale of Frederick’s Exeter Drilling business. Captiva developed into a family-owned platform focused on mineral interests and non-operated exploration-and-production assets across major US basins.

Mayer now serves as Captiva Resources president and leads Captiva Ventures, the family investment office. His portfolio also includes Arta Tequila, which he acquired in 2011 and rebuilt as a premium Colorado-owned brand produced in Mexico. Beyond the office, Mayer is a high-hours commercial pilot qualified in Citation jets and helicopters, an experience that has supported a public life centered on travel, diving and exploration.
long_biography.html:
After earning an economics degree from Denison University, Anthony “Tony” Mayer entered the family’s Denver oil-and-gas world. He founded Savant Resources in 1988 and two years later established Captiva Resources with his father, Frederick Mayer, after the sale of Frederick’s Exeter Drilling business. Captiva developed into a family-owned platform focused on mineral interests and non-operated exploration-and-production assets across major US basins.

Mayer now serves as Captiva Resources president and leads Captiva Ventures, the family investment office. His portfolio also includes Arta Tequila, which he acquired in 2011 and rebuilt as a premium Colorado-owned brand produced in Mexico. Beyond the office, Mayer is a high-hours commercial pilot qualified in Citation jets and helicopters, an experience that has supported a public life centered on travel, diving and exploration.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable Tony Mayer is matched to Anthony R. Mayer through The Big Blue, spouse Delisa, three children, American geography and the unusually specific helicopter-pilot identity. The independent official biography repeats every personal anchor. This reaches certainty despite the common name; no facts from namesake educators, executives or pilots were transferred.

Anthony demonstrably founded Savant and co-founded Captiva Resources. His father's earlier Exeter fortune and Captiva asset-management structure formed a substantial family platform, but public evidence does not disclose Anthony's initial Captiva capital, ownership percentages, inheritance terms or later family distributions. Mixed preserves both evidenced mechanisms without inventing a legal transfer.

Mayer leads both an active family-owned oil-and-gas company and a family investment office, and also owns Arta Tequila. Energy is retained as the primary industry and Founder as the relationship because Captiva's current public materials center upstream acquisitions and identify him as its founder-president; no comparable private asset values are disclosed.

The father's obituary supports the full Anthony Rickard Mayer name and Tony nickname, corroborated by the official Anthony R. Mayer biography. No strong reviewed source establishes birth day, month, year or place, and no secondary nationality or residence is proposed.

Arta Tequila is a long-held, directly controlled brand but no public evidence shows it rivals Captiva economically, so it is tagged without changing the primary industry. Mayer's 5,400-hour commercial status and aircraft qualifications make Pilot a substantial practiced role rather than a tag inferred from aircraft ownership.

The proposed LinkedIn matches exact name, Englewood geography and Denison education but is sparse, so confidence is reduced. The official company website is proposed.
